USDT.what: Tether stablecoin · USDT0 on newer chains

USDE.what: Ethena synthetic dollar · hedged ETH/BTC basis

KBTC.what: Kraken wrapped bitcoin · 1:1 BTC held by Kraken
KBTC.body: kBTC is an ERC-20 wrapped bitcoin issued by Kraken on Ethereum, OP Mainnet, Unichain and Ink at the same address. Each token is backed 1:1 by BTC held in Kraken's custodial wallets, with the custody address published for verification. It earns no yield itself.
KBTC.redemption: Kraken customers (outside restricted regions) deposit kBTC to Kraken and receive BTC 1:1; KYC via Kraken account

Honest Abe::HA.body: Unverified ERC-20 token on Ethereum named Honest Abe (HA). The contract source is not verified, it has 1,000,000 supply and only 2 holders, and no issuer, website or documentation could be found.
Honest Abe::HA.verify: Unidentified token: unverified contract, 2 holders, no price. Reported size is not credible.

Circle Wrapped BTC::CIRBTC.what: Circle wrapped bitcoin · 1:1 BTC in segregated custody
Circle Wrapped BTC::CIRBTC.body: cirBTC is a wrapped bitcoin issued by Circle on Ethereum (launched June 2026) and Arc. Each token is backed 1:1 by native BTC held via Circle's Bermuda affiliate and custodied by Circle National Trust in segregated accounts for holders, with reserves verified on-chain through Chainlink Proof of Reserve. It earns no yield itself.
Circle Wrapped BTC::CIRBTC.backing: BTC held by Circle National Trust (custodial, segregated)
Circle Wrapped BTC::CIRBTC.redemption: Qualified businesses via Circle Mint redeem 1:1 for BTC; KYB required

World Liberty Financial::WLFI.body: WLFI is the governance token of World Liberty Financial, the Trump-family-affiliated DeFi project behind the USD1 stablecoin. Holders vote on protocol proposals; the token does not represent ownership or a claim on protocol revenue. It was non-transferable until a 2025 tokenholder vote enabled trading.

Hastra PRIME::PRIME.what: Hastra staked wYLDS · Figure HELOC lending yield
Hastra PRIME::PRIME.body: PRIME is a yield-bearing token from Hastra, a protocol incubated by Figure and the Provenance Blockchain Foundation. Users lock USDC for wYLDS (wrapped Figure YLDS) and stake wYLDS to mint PRIME, which earns interest from Figure's Democratized Prime facility that funds home equity lines of credit (HELOCs). Figure states it does not issue or sponsor PRIME.
Hastra PRIME::PRIME.backing: HELOC loans via Figure Democratized Prime
Hastra PRIME::PRIME.redemption: Unstake to wYLDS any time, then redeem wYLDS for USDC after an unbonding period subject to redeem-vault liquidity; one pending redemption per address

PayFi Strategy Token::PST.what: Huma Finance PayFi LP token · USDC lent to payment financing
PayFi Strategy Token::PST.body: PST is Huma Finance's yield-bearing LP token, minted when USDC is supplied to Huma's Classic mode; it originated on Solana and is also issued on Ethereum. Deposited USDC funds short-term real-world payment financing (PayFi), such as pre-funding of cross-border payments, and yield accrues to the token in USDC terms.
PayFi Strategy Token::PST.redemption: Redeem for USDC via Huma app subject to pool liquidity and any chosen lockup; or sell on DEX

SYRUPUSDG.what: Maple yield vault on USDG · overcollateralized institutional loans
SYRUPUSDG.body: syrupUSDG is a Maple Finance ERC-4626 pool token launched in July 2026; holders deposit Global Dollar (USDG) and receive shares in a pool of loans. The pool makes fixed-rate, overcollateralized loans to institutional borrowers managed by Maple, and interest accrues to the share price. It carries credit risk and possible principal loss.
SYRUPUSDG.redemption: Withdrawal requests usually filled near-instantly, up to ~24h, max 30 days depending on pool liquidity

Coinbase Wrapped XRP::CBXRP.what: Coinbase wrapped XRP · 1:1 XRP held by Coinbase
Coinbase Wrapped XRP::CBXRP.body: cbXRP is an ERC-20 token on Base issued by Coinbase, backed 1:1 by native XRP held in Coinbase custody. It lets XRP be used in EVM DeFi and earns no yield itself.
Coinbase Wrapped XRP::CBXRP.redemption: Coinbase customers convert cbXRP to XRP 1:1 via Coinbase account; KYC via Coinbase

Staked Stream USD::xUSD.what: Stream Finance staked USD · collapsed Nov 2025, in wind-down
Staked Stream USD::xUSD.body: xUSD is the staked vault token of Stream Finance, which deployed deposits into strategies run by external fund managers. In November 2025 Stream disclosed a ~$93M loss by an external manager, xUSD lost over 90% of its value, and the protocol is now in a wind-down to liquidate and distribute remaining assets to creditors.
Staked Stream USD::xUSD.redemption: Normal redemptions halted; recovery depends on Stream wind-down distributions
Staked Stream USD::xUSD.verify: Defunct: Stream Finance collapsed Nov 2025; xUSD trades near $0.02.

LINK.body: LINK is the native token of Chainlink, a decentralized oracle network that supplies price feeds, proof of reserve and cross-chain messaging (CCIP). It is used to pay node operators and for staking in Chainlink's staking program. It is bridged to many chains.

PT reUSD (USDC) Ethereum::PT-reUSD-10DEC.what: Pendle principal token on reUSD · fixed rate to 10 Dec 2026
PT reUSD (USDC) Ethereum::PT-reUSD-10DEC.body: Pendle principal token that redeems 1:1 for reUSD's accounting asset (USDC) at maturity on 10 Dec 2026; its yield is the fixed discount to maturity. The underlying reUSD is Re Protocol's senior-tranche token, whose deposits back real-world reinsurance treaties via licensed reinsurers and earn a blend of reinsurance premiums and on-chain basis yield.
PT reUSD (USDC) Ethereum::PT-reUSD-10DEC.redemption: Redeem on Pendle at maturity for underlying (USDC value); before maturity sell on Pendle AMM

World Liberty Financial Custodial Asset:.what: Unverified WLFI-named custodial token on Ethereum
World Liberty Financial Custodial Asset:.body: Upgradeable ERC-20 on Ethereum named World Liberty Financial Custodial Asset, with about 2B supply held by only 4 addresses. No documentation from World Liberty Financial describing this token could be found, so its purpose and backing are unconfirmed.
World Liberty Financial Custodial Asset:.verify: Not in World Liberty docs; 4 holders, no trading. May be an internal custody token or an impostor.

Moons::MOON.what: r/CryptoCurrency community token (bridged from Arbitrum Nova)
Moons::MOON.body: MOON is Reddit's r/CryptoCurrency community points token, originally native on Arbitrum Nova; this is the bridged copy on Arbitrum One. It was earned by subreddit contributions and is used for community governance; Reddit ended the Community Points program in 2023 and the token is now community-run.
Moons::MOON.verify: Genuine bridged MOON, but tiny (~$0.24m cap); a large reported size is a pricing error.

RWA Backed Lending by Valos::vUSD.what: Valos private credit vault on Monad · AUSD lent to crypto institutions
RWA Backed Lending by Valos::vUSD.body: vUSD is the ERC-4626 share token of Valos's institutional credit vault on Monad, built on Accountable's vault infrastructure with real-time loan verification. AUSD deposits are lent to Valos, which runs a secured private credit book lending to market makers, prime brokers, exchanges and custodians; interest accrues to the vault.
RWA Backed Lending by Valos::vUSD.backing: secured private credit to crypto institutions
RWA Backed Lending by Valos::vUSD.redemption: Daily redemption window to AUSD, min 100,000 AUSD; non-US professional or US accredited investors only

Wrapped Savings rUSD::WSRUSD.what: Reservoir savings rUSD · yield from T-bills, lending, funding
Wrapped Savings rUSD::WSRUSD.body: wsrUSD is the ERC-4626 wrapped savings version of Reservoir's rUSD stablecoin. rUSD is a multi-collateral stablecoin backed by real-world assets and on-chain strategies, including T-bills, overcollateralized lending and funding-rate strategies; their yield accrues to wsrUSD's exchange rate. wsrUSD has no lock-up and no fees.
Wrapped Savings rUSD::WSRUSD.yieldSource: Reservoir reserve strategies passed to savings rate
Wrapped Savings rUSD::WSRUSD.redemption: Mint/redeem to rUSD any time, permissionless

ELITE::ELIT.body: Unverified ERC-20 on Arbitrum named ELITE (ELIT), an upgradeable proxy with 10B supply and only 4 holders. No issuer, website or documentation could be found.
ELITE::ELIT.verify: Unidentified token: 4 holders, no price, no transfers. Reported size is not credible.

PT AUSD (AUSD) Monad::PT-AUSD-8OCT2026.what: Pendle principal token on Agora AUSD (Monad) · fixed rate to 8 Oct 2026
PT AUSD (AUSD) Monad::PT-AUSD-8OCT2026.body: Pendle principal token for the AUSD market on Monad, which redeems 1:1 for AUSD at maturity on 8 Oct 2026. AUSD is a dollar stablecoin issued by Agora, backed by cash, short-term US Treasuries and repo. AUSD itself does not accrue yield; the PT's fixed return is the discount to maturity, priced from whatever rewards accrue to the matching yield token.
PT AUSD (AUSD) Monad::PT-AUSD-8OCT2026.redemption: Redeem 1:1 for AUSD via Pendle after 8 Oct 2026; before that, sell on the Pendle AMM

United Stables::U.what: United Stables dollar stablecoin · fiat and stablecoin reserves
United Stables::U.body: U is a US-dollar stablecoin issued by United Stables Limited, mainly circulating on BNB Chain with deployments on Ethereum and other chains. Reserves are a mix of fiat at banks, other USD stablecoins (USDT, USDC, USD1) and tokenized short-term government bonds, held with qualified custodians. Chainlink Proof of Reserve publishes on-chain reserve data. U pays no yield.
United Stables::U.redemption: Eligible verified institutions can redeem for approved USD stablecoins through United Stables Limited; retail users exit on the market

Midas Fasanara Global Open::MGLO.what: Midas tokenized note on Fasanara's trade-receivables credit fund
Midas Fasanara Global Open::MGLO.body: mGLO is a limited-recourse note issued by Midas (through a compartment of a Luxembourg securitisation vehicle) that tracks Fasanara Capital's Global Diversified Alternative Debt strategy. The fund finances short-dated trade receivables: invoices sold by small and mid-size businesses, with payment owed by larger corporate debtors. Returns build up in the token's NAV, with no rebases or reward claims.
Midas Fasanara Global Open::MGLO.backing: Private credit (trade receivables, Fasanara fund shares)
Midas Fasanara Global Open::MGLO.yieldSource: Interest and discounts on trade-receivables financing, reflected in NAV
Midas Fasanara Global Open::MGLO.redemption: KYC/greenlisted mint and redeem via Midas vaults; standard monthly cycle at NAV (about 35 days), with faster paid options (instant partial liquidity, OTC buyers) at a discount

Superstate USCC::USCC.what: Superstate/Bitwise crypto carry fund · BTC/ETH basis trades
Superstate USCC::USCC.body: USCC is a tokenized share of the Superstate Crypto Carry Fund, now managed with Bitwise. The fund runs cash-and-carry basis trades on Bitcoin and Ether (including staked ETH), and holds US Treasuries when basis returns are low. Returns build up in the share's NAV.
Superstate USCC::USCC.backing: Delta-neutral BTC/ETH basis positions and US Treasuries
Superstate USCC::USCC.yieldSource: Futures basis, ETH staking and Treasury interest
Superstate USCC::USCC.redemption: Daily subscriptions and redemptions in USD or USDC for KYC'd, allowlisted investors (qualified purchasers); settles T+1/T+2

Treehouse ETH::TETH.what: Treehouse liquid-staking wrapper on wstETH · rate-arbitrage yield
Treehouse ETH::TETH.body: tETH is Treehouse's yield-bearing receipt token, valued in wstETH. Pooled wstETH earns Lido staking rewards, and Treehouse adds yield by capturing the gap between staking returns and ETH borrowing rates on lending markets. Treehouse calls this extra yield Market Efficiency Yield. Yield is credited daily through a rising tETH:wstETH exchange rate.
Treehouse ETH::TETH.yieldSource: ETH staking rewards plus leveraged staking-vs-borrow rate arbitrage
Treehouse ETH::TETH.redemption: Standard redemption to wstETH in about 7 days (small fee); faster exit available for a higher fee

Janus Henderson Anemoy AAA CLO Fund Toke.what: Tokenized Janus Henderson AAA CLO fund (Centrifuge/Anemoy)
Janus Henderson Anemoy AAA CLO Fund Toke.body: JAAA is a permissioned token for shares of the Janus Henderson Anemoy AAA CLO Fund, issued through Anemoy on Centrifuge. Janus Henderson manages the portfolio of AAA-rated collateralized loan obligation tranches. The token's NAV rises as the portfolio's floating-rate interest is earned.
Janus Henderson Anemoy AAA CLO Fund Toke.yieldSource: Floating-rate interest on AAA CLO debt
Janus Henderson Anemoy AAA CLO Fund Toke.redemption: Subscriptions and redemptions in stablecoins for KYC'd, allowlisted investors via Centrifuge/Anemoy

Hyperithm Delta Neutral Vault::aHYPER.what: Hyperithm USDC vault on Monad · delta-neutral crypto strategies
Hyperithm Delta Neutral Vault::aHYPER.body: aHYPER is the share token of an asynchronous-redemption USDC vault on Monad, built on Accountable's vault infrastructure and listed on Accountable's YieldApp. Hyperithm, a digital asset manager based in Tokyo and Seoul, deploys the USDC across market-neutral strategies such as funding-rate arbitrage, Pendle PT positions, lending-rate arbitrage and liquidity provision. Accountable publishes verification data on the positions.
Hyperithm Delta Neutral Vault::aHYPER.backing: USDC deployed in delta-neutral strategies (off-chain and on-chain)
Hyperithm Delta Neutral Vault::aHYPER.yieldSource: Funding rates, basis, lending and Pendle fixed-rate spreads
Hyperithm Delta Neutral Vault::aHYPER.redemption: Asynchronous redemption, processed weekly; minimum 100 USDC

SUSDX.what: Staked USDX (Stables Labs) · collapsed synthetic dollar
SUSDX.body: sUSDX is the ERC-4626 staking vault for USDX, a synthetic dollar from Stables Labs that was meant to be backed by delta-neutral positions on several exchanges. USDX lost its peg in November 2025 and fell to around $0.3 or lower, amid allegations that the team minted unbacked USDX/sUSDX to borrow against it. The Ethereum sUSDX contract now has a tiny supply and trades near $0.01.
SUSDX.backing: Nominally delta-neutral hedged positions; backing impaired after the Nov 2025 collapse
SUSDX.yieldSource: Nominally funding-rate and basis yield (no longer credible)
SUSDX.redemption: Cooldown-based unstake to USDX; USDX itself is not reliably redeemable
SUSDX.verify: Defunct: USDX collapsed Nov 2025; sUSDX trades near $0.01.

APE.what: ApeCoin · ApeCoin DAO governance and ApeChain gas token
APE.body: ApeCoin is the governance and utility token of the ApeCoin DAO, which grew out of the Bored Ape Yacht Club ecosystem. Holders vote on DAO proposals and treasury use, and APE is the native gas token of ApeChain. It is not backed by any assets and earns nothing by itself.

dCOMP::dCOMP.what: API3 wrapper for COMP · 1:1, voting power delegated
dCOMP::dCOMP.body: dCOMP is an ERC-20 wrapper by API3 that holds COMP 1:1 and delegates the wrapped COMP's Compound governance votes to an address set by the wrapper owner. Its main use is as collateral on Morpho (a dCOMP/USDC market), so COMP can be borrowed against while its voting power stays with the delegate. Only whitelisted addresses can wrap.
dCOMP::dCOMP.redemption: Unwrap 1:1 to COMP via the wrapper contract

Ripio Coin::RPC.what: Ripio Coin · rewards token of the Ripio exchange (LatAm)
Ripio Coin::RPC.body: RPC is an ERC-20 token from Ripio, a Latin American crypto exchange and wallet operating since 2013. Ripio users earn RPC as in-app rewards for actions like verification, trading and referrals, and it is used for perks within Ripio's products. It is not backed by assets and earns nothing by itself.

Lista USD::lisUSD.what: Lista DAO overcollateralized CDP stablecoin on BNB Chain
Lista USD::lisUSD.body: lisUSD (formerly HAY) is a decentralized, USD-soft-pegged stablecoin minted by Lista DAO on BNB Chain. Users mint it by locking crypto collateral such as BNB, slisBNB, ETH or BTCB in collateralized debt positions. The peg is maintained by overcollateralization, stability fees and liquidations.
Lista USD::lisUSD.backing: Overcollateralized crypto (BNB, slisBNB, ETH, BTCB, etc.)
Lista USD::lisUSD.redemption: No issuer redemption; borrowers repay lisUSD to unlock collateral, and holders exit via markets

Ondo Short-Term US Government Treasuries.what: Ondo tokenized short-term US Treasury fund
Ondo Short-Term US Government Treasuries.body: OUSG is a token from Ondo Finance representing shares in a fund that holds short-term US Treasuries, mostly through tokenized money-market and Treasury funds such as BlackRock's BUIDL. Treasury interest builds up in the token's price.
Ondo Short-Term US Government Treasuries.backing: Short-term US Treasuries (via funds such as BUIDL) and cash
Ondo Short-Term US Government Treasuries.redemption: KYC'd qualified investors on Ondo's allowlist can mint and redeem in stablecoins; instant mint/redeem is available within limits

PT sUSDe (USDe) Plasma::PT-sUSDE-22OCT20.what: Pendle principal token on sUSDe (Plasma) · fixed rate to 22 Oct 2026
PT sUSDe (USDe) Plasma::PT-sUSDE-22OCT20.body: Pendle principal token for the sUSDe market on Plasma, which redeems 1:1 for USDe-equivalent value at maturity on 22 Oct 2026. sUSDe is Ethena's staked synthetic dollar, which earns yield from hedged ETH/BTC funding and basis plus reserve income. The PT holder gives up that floating yield in exchange for a fixed return from buying at a discount.
PT sUSDe (USDe) Plasma::PT-sUSDE-22OCT20.redemption: Redeem 1:1 for the USDe accounting asset via Pendle after 22 Oct 2026; before that, sell on the Pendle AMM

PT USDat (USDat) Monad::PT-USDat-14JAN20.what: Pendle principal token on Saturn USDat (Monad) · fixed rate to 14 Jan 2027
PT USDat (USDat) Monad::PT-USDat-14JAN20.body: Pendle principal token for the USDat market on Monad, which redeems 1:1 for USDat at maturity on 14 Jan 2027. USDat is a non-yielding stablecoin from Saturn backed by tokenized US Treasuries; its staked version, sUSDat, is the one exposed to Strategy's STRC preferred stock. The PT's fixed return is its discount to maturity, priced from rewards (including Saturn points) that go to the matching yield token.
PT USDat (USDat) Monad::PT-USDat-14JAN20.redemption: Redeem 1:1 for USDat via Pendle after 14 Jan 2027; before that, sell on the Pendle AMM

UNI.body: UNI is the governance token of the Uniswap protocol, a set of decentralized exchange contracts on Ethereum and many other chains. Holders vote on protocol upgrades, fee settings and use of the Uniswap treasury. It is not backed by any assets.

Midas Fasanara ONE::mF-ONE.what: Midas tokenized certificate · tracks Fasanara Capital's F-ONE private credit fund
Midas Fasanara ONE::mF-ONE.body: mF-ONE is issued by Midas and tracks Fasanara Capital's F-ONE fund, which allocates to fintech-originated receivables, SME and real-estate-backed private credit, and market-neutral digital asset strategies (the fund uses leverage). A liquidity sleeve holds Midas mTBILL (tokenized T-bills) and a Fasanara Digital Pareto vault to fund faster redemptions. Returns accrue to the token price via NAV.
Midas Fasanara ONE::mF-ONE.backing: shares in Fasanara F-ONE fund (private credit) plus mTBILL/Pareto liquidity sleeves
Midas Fasanara ONE::mF-ONE.yieldSource: private credit interest and market-neutral strategy returns of the F-ONE fund
Midas Fasanara ONE::mF-ONE.redemption: Midas-onboarded (KYC) holders only; instant from liquidity sleeve when available (fee), otherwise ~30-day notice + 5-day settlement; secondary transfers permissionless

PT USD3 (USDC) Ethereum::PT-USD3-17DEC20.what: Pendle principal token on 3Jane USD3 · fixed rate to 17 Dec 2026
PT USD3 (USDC) Ethereum::PT-USD3-17DEC20.body: Pendle principal token that redeems 1:1 for the USDC value of USD3 at maturity on 17 Dec 2026; its yield is the discount at which it trades before maturity. USD3 is 3Jane's senior-tranche ERC-4626 token: USDC deposits fund credit lines and asset-backed facilities to fintech and crypto-native borrowers, with the junior sUSD3 tranche absorbing losses first.
PT USD3 (USDC) Ethereum::PT-USD3-17DEC20.backing: USD3 (3Jane senior tranche of USDC credit lending)
PT USD3 (USDC) Ethereum::PT-USD3-17DEC20.redemption: permissionless redemption via Pendle at/after 17 Dec 2026; before maturity sell on Pendle AMM

Midas Fasanara Global::MGLOBAL.what: Midas tokenized certificate · tracks Fasanara Global Diversified Alternative Debt
Midas Fasanara Global::MGLOBAL.body: mGLOBAL is issued by Midas and tracks Fasanara Capital's Global Diversified Alternative Debt strategy, a short-duration private credit portfolio of SME asset-backed credit such as trade receivables and digital invoices across many countries. It is a security token issued from a bankruptcy-remote compartment of a Luxembourg securitisation vehicle; returns accrue to the token price via an onchain NAV oracle.
Midas Fasanara Global::MGLOBAL.yieldSource: interest on the underlying alternative-debt portfolio
Midas Fasanara Global::MGLOBAL.redemption: Midas-onboarded (KYC) holders; instant routes via liquidity sleeve/credit facility when available, otherwise standard monthly NAV redemption (~35 days)

CAKE.body: CAKE is the native token of PancakeSwap, a multi-chain DEX originally on BNB Chain. It is used for governance, liquidity mining rewards and fee discounts; under Tokenomics 3.0 (2025) veCAKE locking was retired, emissions were cut and part of trading fees is used to buy and burn CAKE, with max supply reduced to 400M in 2026.

Astherus Staked BNB::asBNB.what: Aster (ex-Astherus) BNB yield token · wraps Lista slisBNB in Binance Launchpools
Astherus Staked BNB::asBNB.body: asBNB is minted on Aster Earn by depositing BNB or slisBNB (Lista DAO's liquid staked BNB). The slisBNB is converted to clisBNB and used to farm Binance Launchpool, HODLer airdrop and Megadrop rewards, which are converted back and added to asBNB's value on top of BNB staking yield.
Astherus Staked BNB::asBNB.yieldSource: BNB staking rewards plus Binance Launchpool/HODLer airdrop/Megadrop rewards
Astherus Staked BNB::asBNB.redemption: permissionless withdrawal to slisBNB; immediate when no Launchpool is active, otherwise queued (~3-5 business days); no fee

Metronome Synth ETH::msETH.what: Metronome synthetic ETH · overcollateralized, minted against crypto deposits
Metronome Synth ETH::msETH.body: msETH is a synthetic asset from Metronome Synth that tracks the price of ETH. Users mint it as debt against overcollateralized deposits (ETH, LSTs, stablecoins and Vesper vault tokens), and it can be swapped with other Metronome synths in the protocol marketplace. It is a LayerZero OFT bridged across Ethereum, Optimism, Base and other chains. In July 2026 an oracle-latency issue left about 6,367 msETH unbacked; the DAO plans to close the gap via treasury buyback-and-burn.
Metronome Synth ETH::msETH.backing: overcollateralized user debt positions (partially underbacked since Jul 2026)
Metronome Synth ETH::msETH.redemption: no direct redemption for ETH; repay debt or swap via Synth marketplace/DEX pools
Metronome Synth ETH::msETH.verify: Jul 2026 post-mortem: ~6,367 msETH left unbacked; traded ~0.88 ETH on 2026-10-06.

Midas Wellington Income Opportunities::M.what: Midas tokenized certificate · Wellington investment-grade multi-sector fixed income
Midas Wellington Income Opportunities::M.body: mWIN is issued by Midas and represents a share in a Luxembourg vehicle holding Wellington Management's Income Opportunities strategy, run by Wellington's Financial Reserves team. The portfolio is investment-grade fixed income: CLOs, CMBS, agency and non-agency RMBS, ABS and IG corporate bonds. Northern Trust provides daily pricing and Ernst & Young audits; returns accrue to the token NAV.
Midas Wellington Income Opportunities::M.yieldSource: coupon income from the fixed income portfolio
Midas Wellington Income Opportunities::M.redemption: Midas-onboarded (KYC) holders; subscribe/redeem in USDC or PYUSD, instant redemption marketed subject to liquidity

K3 x Galaxy Lending::gAUSD.what: Accountable vault share · AUSD credit facility from K3 Capital to Galaxy
K3 x Galaxy Lending::gAUSD.body: gAUSD is the share token of an Accountable vault on Monad through which depositors lend AUSD (Agora's stablecoin) to Galaxy, with K3 Capital managing the facility. Loans run in rollable 90-day terms and Accountable's verification layer reports onchain that capital, facility status and interest match what is stated. Interest paid by Galaxy accrues to the vault.
K3 x Galaxy Lending::gAUSD.yieldSource: interest paid by Galaxy on the loans
K3 x Galaxy Lending::gAUSD.redemption: up to 30% of principal redeemable monthly; eligibility and jurisdictional restrictions apply

apyUSD::APYUSD.what: Apyx savings token · wraps apxUSD, earns DAT preferred-share dividends
apyUSD::APYUSD.body: apyUSD is a non-rebasing ERC-4626 savings vault from Apyx that wraps apxUSD. apxUSD is a synthetic dollar backed by preferred shares issued by digital asset treasury companies (e.g. STRC, SATA) plus short-term Treasuries. Dividends from that basket are streamed to apyUSD through a rising exchange rate.
apyUSD::APYUSD.yieldSource: dividends from preferred shares and T-bill interest
apyUSD::APYUSD.redemption: permissionless deposit; unlock to apxUSD via request, ~20-day cooldown, then claim (faster flexible exit with declining fee from 3 days)

Origin Ether::OETH.what: Origin liquid staking ETH · rebasing, staking yield
Origin Ether::OETH.body: OETH is Origin Protocol's ETH liquid staking token. ETH is staked on the Beacon Chain via compounding validators, and staking rewards are distributed to holders through rebases (wOETH is the non-rebasing wrapper).
Origin Ether::OETH.redemption: permissionless 1:1 ETH withdrawal queue (typically 1-3 days, up to ~8), or swap on Curve

PT sUSDS (USDS) Ethereum::PT-sUSDS-26NOV.what: Pendle principal token on sUSDS · fixed rate to 26 Nov 2026
PT sUSDS (USDS) Ethereum::PT-sUSDS-26NOV.body: Pendle principal token that redeems 1:1 for USDS value of sUSDS at maturity on 26 Nov 2026; its yield is the discount at which it trades before maturity. sUSDS is Sky's (formerly MakerDAO) savings token, which earns the Sky Savings Rate funded by the protocol's lending and RWA revenue.
PT sUSDS (USDS) Ethereum::PT-sUSDS-26NOV.redemption: permissionless redemption via Pendle at/after 26 Nov 2026; before maturity sell on Pendle AMM

Staked thUSD::STHUSD.what: Theo staked dollar · wraps thUSD, hedged gold carry + T-bills
Staked thUSD::STHUSD.body: sthUSD is the staked, yield-bearing form of Theo's thUSD stablecoin. thUSD is backed by thBILL (Theo's tokenized T-bill product) and an off-chain delta-neutral gold strategy (physical gold leased for interest and hedged with short CME gold futures). Unstaked thUSD earns nothing; yield accrues to sthUSD.
Staked thUSD::STHUSD.backing: thBILL (T-bills) and hedged physical gold carry
Staked thUSD::STHUSD.redemption: thUSD primary redemption KYC/whitelisted with a queue; sthUSD unstake queue around 2 weeks
Staked thUSD::STHUSD.verify: An Aug 2026 independent report flags weak on-chain backing and unattested off-chain gold exposure.

msY::msY.what: Main Street yield token · staked msUSD, CME box-spread strategy (collapsed)
msY::msY.body: msY is Main Street Finance's strategy token, minted by staking msUSD and marketed as earning delta-neutral yield from CME options box spreads. In June 2026 Accountable ended its reserve verification for Main Street, msUSD lost about 90% of its value and msY fell 70-85%.
msY::msY.backing: msUSD (claimed box-spread positions; backing unverified since June 2026)
msY::msY.verify: Distressed: reserves attestation withdrawn Jun 2026; msY fell 70-85 %.

Hyperithm Delta Neutral cbBTC Vault::aHy.what: Accountable vault share · Hyperithm delta-neutral strategies on cbBTC
Hyperithm Delta Neutral cbBTC Vault::aHy.body: aHyperBTC is the ERC-4626 share token of Hyperithm's Delta Neutral cbBTC Vault on Monad, built on Accountable's vault infrastructure. Depositors supply cbBTC, which Hyperithm, a Tokyo/Seoul digital asset manager, deploys in delta-neutral strategies to earn BTC-denominated yield. Accountable publishes ongoing proof-of-solvency data.
Hyperithm Delta Neutral cbBTC Vault::aHy.yieldSource: delta-neutral trading/lending strategies (e.g. funding-rate arbitrage, looping)

Midas M1 USD Market Neutral::mM1-USD.what: Midas tokenized certificate · M1 Capital market-neutral USD strategy
Midas M1 USD Market Neutral::mM1-USD.body: mM1-USD is issued by Midas and tracks M1 Capital's market-neutral USD strategies, including price arbitrage, recursive lending and basis trading, with M1 Capital as risk manager. Returns accrue to the token NAV. Strata also offers senior and junior tranches built on mM1-USD.
Midas M1 USD Market Neutral::mM1-USD.backing: USDC deployed in market-neutral crypto strategies
Midas M1 USD Market Neutral::mM1-USD.yieldSource: arbitrage, basis trading and lending returns
Midas M1 USD Market Neutral::mM1-USD.redemption: Midas-onboarded (KYC) holders via Midas; terms not confirmed

USDX.what: Stables Labs synthetic dollar · delta-neutral (depegged Nov 2025)
USDX.body: USDX is a synthetic dollar issued by Stables Labs, marketed as backed by delta-neutral positions (spot hedged with perpetual shorts) on centralized exchanges. It depegged severely in November 2025, falling to about $0.30. Stables Labs then announced a voluntary, phased 'restoration arrangement' with a claim snapshot, but no guarantee of $1 redemption.
USDX.backing: claimed delta-neutral CEX positions; reserves not transparently reported
USDX.redemption: no reliable redemption; voluntary phased recovery plan for snapshot holders
USDX.verify: Depegged since Nov 2025 (~$0.30); recovery plan is voluntary, no guaranteed $1.

Unit Bitcoin::uBTC.what: Unit wrapped BTC on Hyperliquid · BTC held by Unit guardians
Unit Bitcoin::uBTC.body: uBTC is the Bitcoin token of Unit (Hyperunit), the asset tokenization layer for Hyperliquid's HyperCore and HyperEVM. Each uBTC is minted when native BTC is deposited to a Unit-controlled Bitcoin address and is backed 1:1 by that BTC. Deposits and withdrawals are approved by a three-member Guardian network (Unit, Hyperliquid, Infinite Field) using 2-of-3 threshold signing. The token earns nothing itself.
Unit Bitcoin::uBTC.backing: native BTC held in Unit guardian-controlled addresses
Unit Bitcoin::uBTC.redemption: Permissionless withdrawal to a Bitcoin address via Unit; guardians release BTC after Hyperliquid finality

FXRP::FXRP.what: Flare FAssets wrapped XRP · over-collateralized by agent collateral
FXRP::FXRP.body: FXRP is XRP represented as an ERC-20 on Flare through the FAssets system, and bridged to other chains. XRP backing is held on the XRP Ledger by FAssets agents (and a system-controlled Core Vault since v1.3), and agents post over-collateralization on Flare in FLR and approved ERC-20s. If an agent fails to pay out on a redemption, the redeemer is compensated from that agent's collateral plus a premium. FXRP itself earns nothing.
FXRP::FXRP.backing: XRP on the XRP Ledger plus over-collateral posted by FAssets agents
FXRP::FXRP.redemption: Permissionless: burn FXRP via the Asset Manager; agents pay XRP on the XRP Ledger or collateral is paid out on default

vaSTETH Pool::vaSTETH.what: Vesper pool share on stETH · stETH staking plus strategy yield
vaSTETH Pool::vaSTETH.body: vaSTETH is the share token of Vesper Finance's stETH pool (underlying token is Lido stETH). Deposited stETH keeps its staking rewards, and Vesper strategies have used it as collateral to borrow stablecoins that are deployed in other yield venues, with profits converted back into stETH. The pool share's stETH value rises as that yield accrues. It is also accepted as collateral on Metronome Synth.
vaSTETH Pool::vaSTETH.backing: Lido stETH deposited in the Vesper pool
vaSTETH Pool::vaSTETH.yieldSource: stETH staking rewards plus Vesper strategy profits paid in stETH
vaSTETH Pool::vaSTETH.redemption: Withdraw from the Vesper pool for stETH, subject to pool liquidity; no KYC

Tori Staked trUSD::STRUSD.what: Tori staked trUSD · ERC-4626 vault on delta-neutral synthetic dollar
Tori Staked trUSD::STRUSD.body: strUSD is the staked form of trUSD, Tori Finance's synthetic dollar, issued as an ERC-4626 vault share whose trUSD exchange rate rises as strategies earn. trUSD is backed by delta-neutral trading positions rather than bank deposits, including cash-and-carry futures arbitrage and short-duration instruments with non-USD exposure hedged. Tori takes a performance fee inside the exchange rate.
Tori Staked trUSD::STRUSD.backing: delta-neutral trading positions (futures basis, short-duration instruments)
Tori Staked trUSD::STRUSD.yieldSource: returns from Tori's market-neutral strategies, net of a performance fee
Tori Staked trUSD::STRUSD.redemption: Unstake to trUSD after a 7-day cooldown; trUSD mint/redeem at NAV needs KYC, otherwise swap on market

apxUSD::APXUSD.what: Apyx synthetic dollar · backed by Bitcoin-treasury preferred shares
apxUSD::APXUSD.body: apxUSD is Apyx's synthetic dollar, over-collateralized by dividend-paying preferred shares issued by listed digital-asset-treasury companies, such as Strategy's STRC. It pays no yield itself; holders lock it into apyUSD to receive the preferred-share dividends. Because the collateral is preferred equity rather than cash, its value moves with those shares, and apxUSD traded around $0.92-0.93 in early June 2026 when STRC fell below par.
apxUSD::APXUSD.redemption: Mint and redeem are permissioned for institutional partners; other users trade on DEXs
apxUSD::APXUSD.verify: Fell to ~$0.92 in Jun 2026; the peg follows preferred-share prices, not cash reserves.

Saturn sUSDat::SUSDAT.what: Saturn staked USDat · yield from Strategy STRC preferred dividends
Saturn sUSDat::SUSDAT.body: sUSDat is the staked, yield-bearing version of USDat, Saturn's dollar token whose reserves target M0's M (tokenized US Treasuries). When USDat is staked, Saturn moves the backing into STRC (Strategy's preferred stock) exposure, so sUSDat earns STRC dividends and also carries STRC price risk. Yield accrues through a rising sUSDat/USDat exchange rate.
Saturn sUSDat::SUSDAT.backing: STRC preferred stock exposure (USDat itself: tokenized T-bills via M0)
Saturn sUSDat::SUSDAT.redemption: Unstake to USDat; onboarded users mint/redeem USDat 1:1 with USDC in the Saturn app

PT apyUSD (apxUSD) Ethereum::PT-apyUSD-5.what: Pendle principal token on apyUSD · fixed rate to 5 Nov 2026, redeems in apxUSD
PT apyUSD (apxUSD) Ethereum::PT-apyUSD-5.body: This is a Pendle principal token on apyUSD, Apyx's yield-bearing savings token that earns dividends from Bitcoin-treasury preferred shares backing apxUSD. The PT trades at a discount and redeems 1:1 for apxUSD (the accounting asset) at maturity on 5 Nov 2026. apxUSD is backed by preferred equity rather than cash, so its own price can move below $1.
PT apyUSD (apxUSD) Ethereum::PT-apyUSD-5.backing: apyUSD held in the Pendle SY, ultimately DAT preferred shares
PT apyUSD (apxUSD) Ethereum::PT-apyUSD-5.redemption: Redeem on Pendle for apxUSD-equivalent at or after 5 Nov 2026; before then, sell on the Pendle AMM

FBTC.what: Function (formerly Ignition) wrapped BTC · 1:1 BTC in custody
FBTC.body: FBTC (Fire Bitcoin) is an omnichain BTC token issued by Function, formerly Ignition, available on Ethereum and several L2s. It is backed 1:1 by BTC held with Cactus Custody and a federated MPC signer set, and reserves are published through Chainlink proof of reserve. The token earns nothing itself.
FBTC.backing: BTC held by custodians (Cactus Custody / MPC)
FBTC.redemption: Only KYC/KYB-onboarded qualified users and merchants can mint and burn for BTC

Spark Savings USDG::spUSDG.what: Spark Savings vault on USDG (Robinhood Chain) · Spark Liquidity Layer yield
Spark Savings USDG::spUSDG.body: spUSDG is a Spark Savings V2 vault (ERC-4626) on Robinhood Chain (chain 4663) that takes deposits of USDG, the Paxos-issued Global Dollar stablecoin. Spark deploys deposits through the Spark Liquidity Layer, and yield accrues to the share price. It launched as a Robinhood Chain day-one product.
Spark Savings USDG::spUSDG.backing: USDG deployed by the Spark Liquidity Layer
Spark Savings USDG::spUSDG.yieldSource: Spark Liquidity Layer deployments (Sky/USDS savings-rate linked)
Spark Savings USDG::spUSDG.redemption: Permissionless ERC-4626 withdraw to USDG, subject to vault liquidity

Coinbase Wrapped ADA::CBADA.what: Coinbase wrapped Cardano · ADA held by Coinbase
Coinbase Wrapped ADA::CBADA.body: cbADA is an ERC-20 on Base that represents ADA held in Coinbase custody 1:1. Coinbase launched it in June 2025 so ADA could be used in Base DeFi. The token earns nothing itself.
Coinbase Wrapped ADA::CBADA.redemption: Send to a Coinbase account to unwrap to ADA 1:1; Coinbase account (KYC) required

Pareto AA Tranche - FalconXUSDC::AA_Falc.what: Pareto credit vault senior tranche · USDC loan to FalconX
Pareto AA Tranche - FalconXUSDC::AA_Falc.body: AA_FalconXUSDC is the senior (AA) tranche token of Pareto's FalconX Credit Vault, where deposited USDC is lent to the prime broker FalconX. M11 Credit (Maven 11) curates the vault, handles credit checks and covenants, and runs the monthly epochs. Interest from FalconX accrues into the token's NAV. The junior BB tranche has reportedly never been funded, so the AA tranche has no first-loss buffer in practice.
Pareto AA Tranche - FalconXUSDC::AA_Falc.redemption: Monthly epoch redemptions for KYC/KYB-verified non-US accredited lenders (Keyring); 250k USDC minimum
Pareto AA Tranche - FalconXUSDC::AA_Falc.verify: Junior tranche reportedly unfunded: the senior AA tranche has no first-loss buffer.

Superstate Short Duration US Government.what: Tokenized short-term US Treasury fund · now managed by Invesco
Superstate Short Duration US Government.body: USTB is the share token of a short-duration US government securities fund launched by Superstate. Since mid-2026 Invesco Advisers manages the portfolio and the fund was renamed the Invesco Short-Duration U.S. Government Securities Fund; Superstate still runs the token, transfer agency and contracts at the same address. The fund holds short-dated Treasuries and agency securities, and interest accrues to NAV. Only allowlisted investors can hold it.
Superstate Short Duration US Government.backing: short-term US Treasuries and agency securities
Superstate Short Duration US Government.yieldSource: interest on T-bills and agency securities
Superstate Short Duration US Government.redemption: Allowlisted qualified purchasers redeem at NAV by burning or sending to the redemption address

Staked USDS::stUSDS.what: Sky stUSDS · USDS lent to SKY stakers who borrow against SKY
Staked USDS::stUSDS.body: stUSDS is issued by Sky Protocol when USDS is supplied to the stUSDS module, which funds loans to SKY stakers borrowing against their staked SKY. Borrowed USDS earns the SKY borrow rate, and unused USDS earns the Sky Savings Rate. The module is isolated from sUSDS, so stUSDS holders bear losses if liquidations of SKY collateral do not cover the loans.
Staked USDS::stUSDS.backing: USDS loans secured by staked SKY
Staked USDS::stUSDS.yieldSource: SKY borrow rate, plus Sky Savings Rate on idle funds
Staked USDS::stUSDS.redemption: Permissionless withdraw to USDS, limited to unborrowed liquidity in the module

Midas Hyperithm BTC::mHyperBTC.what: Midas tokenized certificate · Hyperithm BTC market-neutral strategy
Midas Hyperithm BTC::mHyperBTC.body: mHyperBTC is a BTC-denominated tokenized certificate issued by Midas (Midas Software GmbH) that tracks a market-neutral strategy, with Hyperithm acting as the appointed risk manager. The strategy uses approaches such as basis trading and funding-rate arbitrage. Returns are reflected in the token's NAV, which is updated periodically.
Midas Hyperithm BTC::mHyperBTC.redemption: Midas mint/redeem for onboarded (KYC) investors; 1 BTC minimum

Metronome Synth USD::msUSD.what: Metronome synthetic dollar · CDP over crypto and Vesper collateral
Metronome Synth USD::msUSD.body: msUSD is a synthetic dollar minted by users of Metronome Synth who deposit collateral such as USDC, ETH, WBTC, sfrxETH and Vesper vault tokens, at 75-85% collateral factors. It is a debt position, not a fiat-reserve stablecoin, and earns nothing itself. On 31 July 2026 msUSD fell about 11% below peg after oracle delays and low fees in the synth swap module left part of the supply unbacked; MetronomeDAO raised fees and committed treasury buybacks to restore backing.
Metronome Synth USD::msUSD.backing: over-collateralized crypto CDPs (USDC, ETH, WBTC, Vesper tokens)
Metronome Synth USD::msUSD.redemption: No direct 1:1 cash redemption; minters repay msUSD to unlock collateral, or swap on market
Metronome Synth USD::msUSD.verify: Depegged ~11 % on 31 Jul 2026 after a collateral shortfall; check the peg.

earnAUSD::earnAUSD.what: Upshift vault on Agora AUSD (Monad) · lending and LP allocation
earnAUSD::earnAUSD.body: earnAUSD is a yield vault on Monad built by Upshift with Agora, whose AUSD is a dollar stablecoin backed 1:1 by cash and equivalents. Deposited AUSD is allocated by the curator, reported as Gamma Research, across Monad lending markets (e.g. Curvance, Euler, Neverland, Morpho) and DEX liquidity. Yield accrues to the share price against AUSD.
earnAUSD::earnAUSD.backing: AUSD deployed in Monad lending markets and DEX pools
earnAUSD::earnAUSD.yieldSource: lending interest and DEX trading fees
earnAUSD::earnAUSD.redemption: Queued withdrawal, typically processed within 72 hours; instant exit for a fee if liquidity allows

Nest BlackOpal LiquidStone II Vault::nOP.what: Nest vault share · BlackOpal LiquidStone II, Brazilian card receivables
Nest BlackOpal LiquidStone II Vault::nOP.body: nOPAL is a Nest (Plume Vaults) share token. The vault takes USDC and holds BlackOpal's LiquidStone II fund, which buys short-dated Brazilian credit-card receivables and hedges the currency back to the dollar; about 96 % sits in LiquidStone, the rest in a Nest treasury vault and cash. Interest builds up in the token's price; nothing is paid out. It moves between EVM chains as one LayerZero token and is also issued on Solana.
Nest BlackOpal LiquidStone II Vault::nOP.backing: BlackOpal LiquidStone II (FX-hedged Brazilian credit-card receivables), a Nest treasury vault, cash
Nest BlackOpal LiquidStone II Vault::nOP.yieldSource: the discount at which card receivables are bought, collected at face value as Visa / Mastercard payments settle; BlackOpal targets ~12 % in USD
Nest BlackOpal LiquidStone II Vault::nOP.redemption: through Nest: instant from a small liquid buffer for a fee (15 bp), otherwise a queue (Nest lists T+1); NAV reported by the issuer and posted on chain by Nest; not for US persons, 46 jurisdictions barred at mint

Hastra AUTO::AUTO.what: Hastra staked wYLDS · funds near-prime US auto loans (Agora Data / Figure)
Hastra AUTO::AUTO.body: AUTO is a share token you get by staking wYLDS with Hastra. The staked capital funds a Democratized Prime pool of near-prime US consumer auto loans, originated by Agora Data and structured by Figure on Provenance. It does not rebase: its value in wYLDS rises, read from Chainlink Data Streams. It carries more credit risk than PRIME.
Hastra AUTO::AUTO.backing: near-prime US consumer auto loans (Agora Data originates, Figure structures), secured by the vehicles
Hastra AUTO::AUTO.yieldSource: interest paid by the auto borrowers, at a utilization-based rate minus a 0.5 % Hastra fee; Hastra targets up to ~9 %, not guaranteed
Hastra AUTO::AUTO.redemption: AUTO → wYLDS in one atomic step, no unbonding (fails while the price feed is stale); wYLDS → USDC through Hastra's operator-run redemption
Hastra AUTO::AUTO.issuer: Hastra (incubated by Figure and the Provenance Blockchain Foundation)

Hastra wYLDS::wYLDS.what: Hastra wrapper of Figure's YLDS · USDC in 1:1, SOFR − 0.5 % paid monthly
Hastra wYLDS::wYLDS.body: wYLDS is Hastra's custodial wrapper over YLDS, Figure's SEC-registered yield-bearing stablecoin. You mint it 1:1 with USDC, which Hastra uses to buy YLDS for its reserve. The price stays about $1; yield is paid monthly as extra wYLDS that you claim on the Hastra dashboard. It is the base token every other Hastra asset (PRIME, AUTO, SMB) is staked from.
Hastra wYLDS::wYLDS.backing: YLDS held 1:1 in reserve (Figure Certificate Company; prime money-market-type securities)
Hastra wYLDS::wYLDS.yieldSource: the YLDS reserve's interest, SOFR minus 0.5 %, distributed monthly as claimable wYLDS; staked wYLDS stops earning it
Hastra wYLDS::wYLDS.redemption: request_redeem / complete_redeem to USDC through Hastra's operator, batched (currently $2k minimum), can wait on banking hours, one pending request per address; or swap on Raydium

hyUSD::hyUSD::solana.what: Hylo stablecoin · backed by the stable halves of SOL-LST, cbBTC, HYPE and USDC pools
hyUSD::hyUSD::solana.body: hyUSD is Hylo's $1 stablecoin on Solana. Each Hylo collateral pool (SOL LSTs, cbBTC, HYPE, USDC) is split into a leveraged xAsset that takes the price swings and a $1 virtual stablecoin; hyUSD is backed 1:1 by the sum of those. The protocol targets a 150 % collateral ratio and defends it with routing, fees, mint blocks and, last, the Earn Pool.
hyUSD::hyUSD::solana.backing: the $1 virtual-stablecoin halves of Hylo's collateral pools (SOL LSTs, cbBTC, HYPE, USDC); xAssets absorb the volatility
hyUSD::hyUSD::solana.redemption: mint from USDC at 0 %, redeem to USDC at 0.2 % while Pyth USDC/USD is near $1

Earn Hylo USD::eHYUSD::solana.what: Hylo Earn Pool share (ex-sHYUSD) · hyUSD earning LST yield and xAsset borrow fees
Earn Hylo USD::eHYUSD::solana.body: eHYUSD (formerly sHYUSD) is a pro-rata share of the hyUSD deposited in Hylo's Earn Pool. Each epoch the harvested yield is minted as hyUSD into the pool, so eHYUSD's value in hyUSD rises; it does not rebase. It is first-loss capital: if a pool's collateral ratio falls below 100 %, Earn Pool hyUSD is burned to recapitalize it and harvesting pauses.
Earn Hylo USD::eHYUSD::solana.backing: hyUSD in the Earn Pool, first-loss for the hyUSD pools
Earn Hylo USD::eHYUSD::solana.yieldSource: SOL LST staking rewards from the SOL pool plus borrow fees paid by xBTC and xHYPE holders, after a treasury share

Hylo Leveraged SOL::xSOL::solana.what: Hylo leveraged SOL · ~3x at the 150 % target, no liquidations or margin calls
Hylo Leveraged SOL::xSOL::solana.body: xSOL is the leveraged half of Hylo's SOL pool: its price is the pool's TVL minus the virtual stablecoin backing hyUSD, divided by xSOL supply. Leverage moves with the pool's collateral ratio (about 3x at the 150 % target), there are no liquidations or margin calls, and it loses value to volatility decay in sideways markets.
Hylo Leveraged SOL::xSOL::solana.backing: the residual of Hylo's SOL LST pool after the hyUSD claim
Hylo Leveraged SOL::xSOL::solana.redemption: mint and redeem against the pool at flat, configurable fees

Hylo Staked SOL::hyloSOL::solana.what: Hylo liquid-staked SOL · collateral in hyUSD's SOL pool
Hylo Staked SOL::hyloSOL::solana.body: hyloSOL is Hylo's liquid staking token, staked to Hylo's validator (run with Sentinel and Phase Labs). It is collateral in hyUSD's SOL pool alongside jitoSOL.

Hylo SOL Plus::hyloSOL+::solana.what: Hylo SOL Plus · SOL exposure at 0 % APR, its yield boosts hyloSOL; 5x Hylo XP
Hylo SOL Plus::hyloSOL+::solana.body: hyloSOL+ gives SOL exposure without yield: its staking rewards go to boosting hyloSOL, and holders earn 5x points in Hylo's XP system instead.

sUSDS::SUSDS.what: Sky savings rate on USDS · RWA T-bills + crypto-collateral loan fees
sUSDS::SUSDS.body: sUSDS is Sky's (ex-MakerDAO) non-rebasing ERC-4626 vault for USDS; its exchange rate rises every block at the Sky Savings Rate (SSR) set by Sky governance. The rate is paid out of Sky's protocol revenue: stability fees on USDS borrowed against ETH, wstETH and other crypto collateral, tokenized T-bill and other RWA allocations, and capital deployed by Sky's allocators such as the Spark Liquidity Layer. Deposited USDS itself is not lent out; it sits in the savings contract.
sUSDS::SUSDS.backing: USDS held in the Sky Savings Rate contract
sUSDS::SUSDS.yieldSource: Sky revenue: stability fees on crypto-collateral loans, RWA/T-bill allocations, allocator (Spark) yield
sUSDS::SUSDS.redemption: permissionless, instant redeem to USDS at current exchange rate; no fees

SDAI.what: Sky savings DAI (legacy DSR) · RWA T-bills + crypto-collateral loan fees
SDAI.body: sDAI is an ERC-4626 wrapper of DAI deposited in Sky's Dai Savings Rate (DSR) Pot contract; its exchange rate rises as the DSR accrues. The DSR is funded from the same Sky revenue as the Sky Savings Rate (stability fees on crypto-collateral loans plus RWA/T-bill allocations), but governance sets it separately and it has generally been kept below the SSR since the DAI-to-USDS migration. DAI in the Pot is not lent out.
SDAI.backing: DAI held in Sky's DSR (Pot) contract
SDAI.yieldSource: Sky revenue: stability fees on crypto-collateral loans and RWA/T-bill allocations
SDAI.redemption: permissionless, instant redeem to DAI at current exchange rate
SDAI.issuer: Sky (formerly MakerDAO); token deployed via Spark
SDAI.verify: Legacy product: most savings capital has moved to sUSDS and the DSR is set separately (lower) than the SSR.

Spark Savings USDC::SPUSDC.what: Spark savings vault on USDC · Spark Liquidity Layer lending + RWA allocation
Spark Savings USDC::SPUSDC.body: spUSDC is a Spark Savings V2 ERC-4626 vault on Ethereum; deposits of USDC mint shares whose exchange rate rises at a vault rate set by Spark governance. Deposits are deployed by the Spark Liquidity Layer across Spark's balance sheet: SparkLend, Aave and Morpho lending markets, tokenized RWA/T-bill strategies and Sky's sUSDS. A liquidity buffer serves instant withdrawals.
Spark Savings USDC::SPUSDC.backing: USDC deployed via the Spark Liquidity Layer
Spark Savings USDC::SPUSDC.yieldSource: lending interest on SparkLend/Aave/Morpho, RWA/T-bill yield, sUSDS
Spark Savings USDC::SPUSDC.redemption: instant from a liquidity buffer (up to ~$10M); larger exits via liquidity intents, usually filled within minutes

Spark Savings USDT::SPUSDT.what: Spark savings vault on USDT · SparkLend/Morpho lending, syrupUSDT, DEX LP
Spark Savings USDT::SPUSDT.body: spUSDT is a Spark Savings V2 ERC-4626 vault on Ethereum; deposited USDT earns a governance-set vault rate through a rising exchange rate. The Spark Liquidity Layer lends the USDT primarily on SparkLend, sends overflow to Morpho blue-chip vaults, makes a capped allocation to Maple's syrupUSDT, and places USDT in Curve/Uniswap pools; idle buffers earn the Sky Savings Rate via sUSDS. Spark describes the vault as backed by USDS.
Spark Savings USDT::SPUSDT.backing: USDT deployed via the Spark Liquidity Layer (backstopped by USDS)
Spark Savings USDT::SPUSDT.yieldSource: SparkLend and Morpho lending interest, capped syrupUSDT allocation, DEX fees, sUSDS on idle cash
Spark Savings USDT::SPUSDT.redemption: instant from a liquidity buffer; larger exits via liquidity intents, usually filled within minutes

Spark USDC Vault::sUSDC.what: Spark savings USDC (v1) · USDC routed into Sky Savings Rate via sUSDS
Spark USDC Vault::sUSDC.body: sUSDC is Spark's legacy (V1) ERC-4626 USDC savings vault, deployed on Ethereum and on Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Unichain. USDC deposits are swapped 1:1 into USDS/sUSDS through Sky's peg stability module (PSM3 on L2s), so holders earn the Sky Savings Rate through a rising exchange rate. The SSR is funded by Sky's stability fees and RWA/T-bill allocations.
Spark USDC Vault::sUSDC.backing: sUSDS held via Sky's PSM (PSM3 on L2s)
Spark USDC Vault::sUSDC.yieldSource: Sky Savings Rate (stability fees on crypto loans + RWA/T-bills)
Spark USDC Vault::sUSDC.redemption: instant 1:1 swap back to USDC at the current rate, no protocol fee

SYRUPUSDC.what: Maple lending pool of USDC · overcollateralized loans to crypto institutions
SYRUPUSDC.body: syrupUSDC is the ERC-4626 LP token of Maple's Syrup USDC pool; interest accrues to the share price. Maple Direct lends the pool's USDC to crypto-native institutions that post liquid digital assets as collateral, monitored for collateralization, and also deploys capital into futures basis (cash-and-carry) trades and DeFi liquidity provision. Losses from borrower defaults would be borne by the pool.
SYRUPUSDC.backing: USDC loans to institutions, collateralized by liquid crypto
SYRUPUSDC.yieldSource: interest on overcollateralized institutional loans, plus basis trading and DeFi LP
SYRUPUSDC.redemption: deposits restricted in some jurisdictions; withdrawals via FIFO queue, usually within 24h, up to 30 days

SYRUPUSDT.what: Maple lending pool of USDT · overcollateralized loans to crypto institutions
SYRUPUSDT.body: syrupUSDT is the ERC-4626 LP token of Maple's Syrup USDT pool; interest accrues to the share price. Maple Direct lends the pool's USDT to crypto-native institutions that post liquid digital assets as collateral, and also deploys capital into futures basis trades and DeFi liquidity provision. Losses from borrower defaults would be borne by the pool.
SYRUPUSDT.backing: USDT loans to institutions, collateralized by liquid crypto
SYRUPUSDT.yieldSource: interest on overcollateralized institutional loans, plus basis trading and DeFi LP
SYRUPUSDT.redemption: deposits restricted in some jurisdictions; withdrawals via FIFO queue, usually within 24h, up to 30 days

SUSDE.what: Ethena staked USDe · earns perp funding/basis + staked-ETH and reserve yield
SUSDE.body: sUSDe is Ethena's non-rebasing ERC-4626 vault for USDe; protocol revenue is periodically added to the vault, raising the exchange rate. USDe is backed by crypto assets (BTC, ETH, staked ETH) hedged with short perpetual/futures positions, plus stablecoins and short-duration RWAs. Yield comes from funding and basis spreads on the hedges, staked-ETH rewards and income on the stable reserves; when funding is negative stakers may receive nothing and the reserve fund absorbs losses.
SUSDE.backing: USDe (delta-hedged BTC/ETH/staked ETH + stablecoins and short-duration RWAs)
SUSDE.yieldSource: perp funding and basis spread, staked-ETH rewards, stablecoin/RWA reserve yield
SUSDE.redemption: unstake via cooldown (dynamic 1-7 days) into a silo, then claim USDe; or sell on market

Savings crvUSD::scrvUSD.what: Curve savings crvUSD · DAO-set share of crvUSD mint-market borrow fees
Savings crvUSD::scrvUSD.body: scrvUSD is an ERC-4626 vault (based on Yearn V3) that holds crvUSD and rises in value against it. Interest paid by crvUSD borrowers in Curve's mint markets flows through a fee splitter and rewards handler, which sends a DAO-set share to the vault. Deposited crvUSD stays idle in the vault and is not lent out.
Savings crvUSD::scrvUSD.backing: crvUSD held idle in the vault
Savings crvUSD::scrvUSD.yieldSource: DAO-set share of crvUSD borrowing fees
Savings crvUSD::scrvUSD.redemption: permissionless, instant redeem to crvUSD at current rate

Staked Frax USD::sfrxUSD.what: Frax staked frxUSD · rotates between carry trade, DeFi AMOs and T-bills
Staked Frax USD::sfrxUSD.body: sfrxUSD is a non-rebasing ERC-4626 vault for frxUSD whose redemption rate rises as yield is added. Frax's Benchmark Yield Strategy, governed by the Frax DAO, moves capital to the best of three sources: carry trades (e.g. Ethena, Superstate), DeFi yield via AMOs (Aave, Curve, Convex) and T-bill/RWA funds (e.g. BlackRock, FinresPBC).
Staked Frax USD::sfrxUSD.yieldSource: Benchmark Yield Strategy: carry trade, DeFi AMOs or T-bills/RWA
Staked Frax USD::sfrxUSD.redemption: permissionless, instant redeem to frxUSD, no unstaking fee

sDOLA::SDOLA.what: Inverse Finance staked DOLA · FiRM fixed-rate borrower DBR revenue
sDOLA::SDOLA.body: sDOLA is an ERC-4626 wrapper around Inverse Finance's DOLA Savings Account; its exchange rate rises as revenue accrues. FiRM borrowers pay for fixed-rate loans by spending DBR (DOLA Borrowing Rights); part of that revenue goes to the savings account as DBR, which is converted to DOLA through the DAO's XY=K auction and compounded. Deposited DOLA is not rehypothecated.
sDOLA::SDOLA.backing: DOLA held in the DOLA Savings Account
sDOLA::SDOLA.yieldSource: DBR revenue from FiRM fixed-rate lending, auctioned into DOLA
sDOLA::SDOLA.redemption: permissionless, instant unwrap to DOLA, no penalty

f(x) USD Saving::fxSAVE.what: f(x) Protocol stability-pool vault of fxUSD/USDC · leverage fees + wstETH yield

Angle Staked USDA::stUSD.what: Angle savings token on USDA · T-bill ETF + Morpho USDC vault yield, in wind-down
Angle Staked USDA::stUSD.body: stUSD is Angle's yield-bearing wrapper of the USDA dollar stablecoin; its value rises against USDA at a savings rate that Angle governance set weekly through a guardian multisig, based on reserve income and savings utilization. Anzen Staked USDz::SUSDZ.what: Anzen staked USDz · US private-credit ABS (SMB receivables, leases, loans)
Anzen Staked USDz::SUSDZ.body: sUSDz is Anzen's staked form of USDz; the sUSDz balance stays the same while its USDz value rises as rewards are distributed. USDz is backed by a portfolio of overcollateralized, US-based private-credit asset-backed notes (e.g. SMB merchant receivables, invoice factoring, equipment and auto leases, installment loans) with concentration limits. Astherus Staked USDF::asUSDF.what: Aster staked USDF · delta-neutral spot-long/perp-short funding on Binance
Astherus Staked USDF::asUSDF.body: asUSDF is the yield-bearing staked form of Aster's (formerly Astherus) USDF, which is minted 1:1 against USDT. The USDT sits with custodian Ceffu and is used to buy a basket of spot tokens while matching perp shorts are opened on Binance, so the position earns funding fees with little price exposure. Profits are booked weekly into the asUSDF contract and show up as a rising asUSDF/USDF exchange rate.
Astherus Staked USDF::asUSDF.backing: USDF (USDT held at Ceffu in delta-neutral basis positions)
Astherus Staked USDF::asUSDF.yieldSource: perp funding fees from spot-long/perp-short hedges on Binance

Compounding Open Dollar::CUSDO.what: OpenEden wrapped USDO · tokenized T-bill funds (TBILL, BUIDL, USYC, VBILL)
Compounding Open Dollar::CUSDO.body: cUSDO is the non-rebasing ERC-4626 wrapper of OpenEden's rebasing USDO stablecoin; yield shows up as a rising cUSDO price rather than daily rebases, and it earns the same as USDO. USDO reserves are tokenized short-term US Treasury and repo funds: OpenEden TBILL, BlackRock BUIDL (Securitize), VanEck VBILL and Circle/Hashnote USYC. Treasury interest is passed through to holders.
Compounding Open Dollar::CUSDO.yieldSource: US Treasury bill and reverse repo interest
Compounding Open Dollar::CUSDO.redemption: wrap/unwrap cUSDO to USDO anytime; USDO mint/redeem for USDC requires KYC onboarding

Reservoir srUSD::SRUSD.what: Reservoir savings rUSD · RWA credit, DeFi money markets + crypto-backed loans
Reservoir srUSD::SRUSD.body: srUSD is Reservoir's savings token minted from the rUSD stablecoin; it accrues interest daily at a rate set by Reservoir governance according to the balance sheet. rUSD reserves (USDC) are routed through asset adapters into RWA products from approved curators, on-chain money markets and yield protocols (e.g. Morpho, Euler, Ethena, Pendle) and crypto-backed lending. srUSD is paid from that balance-sheet income.
Reservoir srUSD::SRUSD.backing: rUSD (USDC deployed to RWA, DeFi and crypto-backed lending)
Reservoir srUSD::SRUSD.yieldSource: RWA credit, DeFi lending/yield protocols and crypto-backed loans
Reservoir srUSD::SRUSD.redemption: no lock-up; redeem anytime via PSM while it has liquidity; burn fee of one day's interest

Resolv wstUSR::WSTUSR.what: Resolv wrapped staked USR · ETH staking + perp-short funding, in recovery
Resolv wstUSR::WSTUSR.body: wstUSR is the non-rebasing wrapper of stUSR, Resolv's staked USR, and its value rises against USR. USR was backed by a delta-neutral pool of staked ETH (wstETH and others) and BTC hedged with short perps; staking rewards and funding were split between stUSR and the junior RLP tranche, with RLP taking a risk premium and absorbing losses. On 22 March 2026 a compromised minting key let an attacker mint about 80M unbacked USR; Resolv paused, and its May 2026 recovery plan paid 1 USDC per pre-incident USR (0.5 for post-incident) with claims open until 26 August 2026.
Resolv wstUSR::WSTUSR.backing: USR (pre-incident collateral pool: staked ETH/BTC hedged with perp shorts)
Resolv wstUSR::WSTUSR.yieldSource: ETH staking rewards and perp funding (historical)

SUSN.what: Noon staked USN · T-bills, CLOs, private credit, DeFi lending + perp funding arb
SUSN.body: sUSN is Noon's staked form of the USN stablecoin; its value comes from the USN held in the staking pool divided by sUSN supply, and strategy returns are added by minting USN into that pool. USN reserves are spread across governance-approved strategies: tokenized T-bills, AAA CLO tranches, private-credit funds, DeFi stablecoin lending, Pendle-style principal tokens, looping and delta-neutral funding-rate arbitrage. Returns are split 80/10/10, with sUSN holders getting the 80% share.
SUSN.backing: USN (reserves across T-bills, CLOs, private credit, DeFi and basis trades)
SUSN.yieldSource: T-bill, CLO and private-credit interest, DeFi lending, funding-rate arbitrage

Savings Usdd::sUSDD.what: USDD savings vault · Smart Allocator lends reserves on Aave, Spark, Morpho
Savings Usdd::sUSDD.body: sUSDD is the ERC-4626 savings vault for USDD, the TRON-ecosystem overcollateralized stablecoin; its exchange rate against USDD rises as yield accrues. Yield comes from the Smart Allocator, which deploys USDD's cash reserves (stablecoins) into lending markets such as Aave, Spark, Morpho and JustLend, keeps part as a risk reserve and passes the rest to stakers. The rate has been managed by the USDD/JUST DAO teams, e.g. reset to a 5% base APY in 2026.
Savings Usdd::sUSDD.yieldSource: lending interest from Smart Allocator deployments on Aave/Spark/Morpho
Savings Usdd::sUSDD.redemption: redeem sUSDD to USDD anytime, no lock; USDD to stablecoins via PSM

Staked Falcon USD::sUSDf.what: Falcon staked USDf · funding/basis arb, cross-venue arb + altcoin staking
Staked Falcon USD::sUSDf.body: sUSDf is Falcon Finance's ERC-4626 vault on USDf, a synthetic dollar minted against stablecoins, BTC, ETH, altcoins and tokenized RWAs (gold, T-bills, equities). Yield shows up as a rising sUSDf/USDf exchange rate. It comes from mostly market-neutral trading of the collateral: positive and negative funding-rate arbitrage, spot/perp basis, cross-exchange arbitrage, native altcoin staking, DEX liquidity provision, options and statistical arbitrage.
Staked Falcon USD::sUSDf.backing: USDf (overcollateralized stablecoins, crypto and tokenized RWAs)
Staked Falcon USD::sUSDf.yieldSource: funding/basis arbitrage, cross-venue arbitrage, altcoin staking, LP and options
Staked Falcon USD::sUSDf.redemption: unstake sUSDf to USDf instantly; USDf redemption to stables 7-day cooldown, KYC required

Staked InfiniFi USD::siUSD.what: infiniFi staked iUSD · fractional-reserve mix of Aave/Spark lending and Pendle PTs
Staked InfiniFi USD::siUSD.body: siUSD is the liquid staked form of iUSD, infiniFi's USDC-backed receipt dollar; yield is streamed in over 8-hour epochs and accrues in the siUSD price. infiniFi runs an on-chain fractional reserve: liquid deposits sit in liquid farms (Aave, Spark sUSDC) while capital locked as liUSD lets the protocol also allocate into longer-duration farms such as Pendle principal tokens. Protocol yield is shared between siUSD and liUSD holders, so siUSD earns more than the raw liquid lending rate; plain iUSD earns nothing. Since the June 2025 upgrade siUSD is no longer ERC-4626 and staking/unstaking go through infiniFi's Gateway.
Staked InfiniFi USD::siUSD.yieldSource: lending on Aave/Spark plus Pendle PT yield, boosted by locked-capital duration
Staked InfiniFi USD::siUSD.redemption: instant unstake to iUSD via Gateway; iUSD redeems 1:1 to USDC, queued if liquid reserves are short

Staked Level USD::SLVLUSD.what: Level staked lvlUSD · was Aave/Morpho USDC-USDT lending; protocol wound down
Staked Level USD::SLVLUSD.body: slvlUSD is the ERC-4626 staking vault for lvlUSD, Level's dollar backed by USDC and USDT. The reserves were lent on blue-chip lending markets (Aave, Morpho) and all of that lending yield went to stakers through a rising slvlUSD/lvlUSD rate. In September 2025 the Level team joined Grove (Sky ecosystem) and sunset the protocol: minting stopped, the last yield distribution was on 2 October 2025, and the cooldown was cut to near-zero so holders can exit.
Staked Level USD::SLVLUSD.yieldSource: none since Oct 2025; previously Aave/Morpho lending interest

Staked NUSD::sNUSD.what: Neutrl staked NUSD · hedged OTC altcoin discounts + basis; paused, redeeming ~0.51
Staked NUSD::sNUSD.body: sNUSD is the staking vault for NUSD, Neutrl's synthetic dollar minted against USDC, USDT or USDe, and took all protocol revenue through a rising exchange rate. Reserves bought discounted locked altcoins in OTC deals (via STIX) hedged with perp shorts, plus delta-neutral basis trades and yield-bearing stablecoins. A redemption portal run by Caverna Auctus Inc. opened 17 September 2026 paying USDC at a fixed rate of about 0.51 per token against disclosed liquid reserves, expected open until 14 November 2026.

Staked UTY::YUTY.what: YieldPoint (ex-XSY) staked UTY · market-neutral perp funding and basis trades
Staked UTY::YUTY.body: yUTY is the yield-bearing vault share on UTY (Unity), YieldPoint's dollar token; YieldPoint is the rebrand of XSY. UTY is minted 1:1 against USDC on Base, the USDC is swept to a custodian, and it is deployed into market-neutral strategies (originally long AVAX spot / short AVAX perps) that earn funding and basis. Staked YUSD::sYUSD.what: Aegis staked YUSD · BTC collateral hedged with short perps, earns funding
Staked YUSD::sYUSD.body: sYUSD is the ERC-4626 staking vault for YUSD, Aegis's synthetic dollar backed by bitcoin held with institutional custodians (Fireblocks, Copper, Ceffu). The BTC is hedged with short BTC perpetuals on major exchanges, so the position is delta-neutral, and the funding paid by longs is the yield. sYUSD auto-compounds that yield into a rising sYUSD/YUSD rate instead of the weekly claims plain YUSD holders make.
Staked YUSD::sYUSD.backing: YUSD (custodied BTC hedged with short BTC perps)

Staked avUSD::savUSD.what: Avant staked avUSD · senior tranche of delta-neutral basis, lending and LP strategies
Staked avUSD::savUSD.body: savUSD is the ERC-4626 staking token on avUSD, Avant's dollar backed 1:1 by USDC on Avalanche, and is the senior tranche of Avant's yield. Deposits go to market-neutral strategies run with trading partners: spot/short-futures basis trades, lending-rate arbitrage, Pendle yield trading, Aave supply and Curve/Uniswap liquidity. Profits raise the savUSD/avUSD rate, and the junior avUSDx tranche takes strategy losses first.
Staked avUSD::savUSD.backing: avUSD (USDC), protected by the avUSDx junior tranche
Staked avUSD::savUSD.yieldSource: basis trades, lending arbitrage, Pendle, Aave, DEX liquidity
Staked avUSD::savUSD.redemption: 1-day cooldown savUSD to avUSD (no yield during it); avUSD redeems to USDC

Staked cap USD::stcUSD.what: Cap staked cUSD · loans to restaker-covered market makers + Aave on idle USDC
Staked cap USD::stcUSD.body: stcUSD is the ERC-4626 staking vault for cUSD, Cap's dollar backed 1:1 by stablecoin reserves (USDC). Institutional operators such as market makers and trading firms borrow from the reserve, and their credit is covered by restaked collateral delegated via Symbiotic/EigenLayer that is slashed on default. stcUSD earns the borrow interest above the hurdle rate plus underwriting premiums, and idle reserves are swept into Aave V3.
Staked cap USD::stcUSD.backing: cUSD (USDC reserve, lent to operators covered by restakers)
Staked cap USD::stcUSD.yieldSource: operator borrow interest and underwriting premiums, plus Aave yield on idle reserve
Staked cap USD::stcUSD.redemption: unstake to cUSD; cUSD redeems from the reserve's unlent buffer

3Jane USD3::USD3.what: 3Jane senior credit tranche on USDC · fintech receivables + crypto credit lines
3Jane USD3::USD3.body: USD3 is the senior ERC-4626 token minted when USDC is supplied to 3Jane. The USDC funds Fintech Credit Conduits (short-duration SMB and consumer receivables financed through SPVs) and unsecured crypto credit lines, with idle cash in Aave. USD3 earns a fixed share of whatever the pool earns, and losses hit originator equity, overcollateralization, reserves and the sUSD3 junior tranche before USD3.
3Jane USD3::USD3.backing: USDC lent to fintech originators and crypto borrowers; idle USDC in Aave
3Jane USD3::USD3.yieldSource: interest on fintech receivables and crypto credit lines
3Jane USD3::USD3.redemption: redeem to USDC up to the tranche ratio, from Aave cash and amortizing loans; 1,000 USDC minimum deposit

3Jane Staked USD3::sUSD3.what: 3Jane junior first-loss tranche on USD3 · levered fintech and crypto credit yield
3Jane Staked USD3::sUSD3.body: sUSD3 is the junior tranche minted by staking USD3, and its supply is capped by a tranche ratio (e.g. ~15% of debt). It earns a larger, levered share of the same pool income from fintech receivables and crypto credit lines. It absorbs credit losses after originator equity, overcollateralization and reserves but before senior USD3; low yields alone do not cut its principal.
3Jane Staked USD3::sUSD3.yieldSource: levered share of interest on fintech receivables and crypto credit lines
3Jane Staked USD3::sUSD3.redemption: 1-month lock, then cooldown and a withdrawal window back to USD3

sUSD1+::sUSD1+.what: Lorenzo USD1+ fund share · RWA yield, CEX delta-neutral basis and DeFi in USD1
sUSD1+::sUSD1+.body: sUSD1+ is the non-rebasing share of Lorenzo Protocol's USD1+ On-chain Traded Fund on BNB Chain, run with World Liberty Financial's USD1; USD1+ is the rebasing version of the same fund. Deposits of USD1, USDT or USDC go into three sleeves: tokenized real-world assets, a delta-neutral basis strategy on centralized exchanges, and DeFi yield. Returns are settled in USD1 and show up as a rising NAV per sUSD1+.
sUSD1+::sUSD1+.backing: USD1+ OTF assets (RWA, CEX basis positions, DeFi), settled in USD1
sUSD1+::sUSD1+.yieldSource: RWA interest, CEX delta-neutral basis/funding, DeFi yield

Wrapped iTRY::WITRY.what: Brix staked iTRY · Turkish lira money market fund yield (TRY-denominated)
Wrapped iTRY::WITRY.body: wiTRY is the ERC-4626 vault share on iTRY, Brix's Turkish-lira token backed by a tokenized basket of liquid Turkish money market funds. Each cycle (currently weekly) Brix measures the funds' NAV gain and mints the lira-denominated yield into the vault, so wiTRY redeems for more iTRY over time. The canonical vault is on Ethereum and reaches MegaETH through LayerZero OVault. Value is in TRY, not USD, so the lira rate drives dollar returns.
Wrapped iTRY::WITRY.backing: iTRY (tokenized Turkish lira money market funds)
Wrapped iTRY::WITRY.yieldSource: Turkish money market fund interest (lira rates)

Wren Staked tGBP::wstGBP.what: Wren staked tGBP · share of tGBP reserve income from gilts, cash and MMFs
Wren Staked tGBP::wstGBP.body: wstGBP is a non-rebasing ERC-20 wrapper around tGBP, the sterling stablecoin issued by FCA-registered BCP Technologies. A commercial agreement between BCP and Wren Spire passes part of the income from tGBP's reserves (UK gilts, sterling cash and money market funds) to the wrapper. That income lands as periodic NAV updates to the wstGBP/tGBP rate, which is in GBP, not USD.
Wren Staked tGBP::wstGBP.backing: tGBP (sterling cash, UK gilts, money market funds)
Wren Staked tGBP::wstGBP.yieldSource: share of tGBP reserve interest paid to Wren under a commercial agreement with BCP
Wren Staked tGBP::wstGBP.redemption: permissionless mint; instant on-chain redeem to tGBP at NAV less a 25 bps fee, no cooldown
Wren Staked tGBP::wstGBP.issuer: Wren Spire (BVI) Ltd, an Arb Capital company

Strata Senior USDe::SRUSDE.what: Strata senior tranche of sUSDe · Aave-rate floor, junior first-loss cover, sUSDe upside
Strata Senior USDe::SRUSDE.body: srUSDe is the senior (protected) tranche of Strata's Ethena market: an ERC-4626 token whose exchange rate to USDe only rises. The pooled USDe is staked as sUSDe, which earns Ethena's perp funding/basis carry plus staking yield; srUSDe takes a share of that with a floor at the supply-weighted Aave v3 Core USDC/USDT lending rate, paying a risk premium to jrUSDe. jrUSDe is first-loss capital, so srUSDe only loses principal if the junior tranche is wiped out.
Strata Senior USDe::SRUSDE.backing: USDe staked as sUSDe, over-collateralized by the jrUSDe first-loss tranche
Strata Senior USDe::SRUSDE.yieldSource: sUSDe yield (perp funding + basis carry + staked-ETH), floored at the Aave USDC/USDT supply rate
Strata Senior USDe::SRUSDE.redemption: permissionless; instant redeem to sUSDe or USDe after Ethena's 7-day cooldown; 2.5 bps fee; mint paused if coverage < 105%

Strata Junior USDe::jrUSDe.what: Strata junior tranche of sUSDe · levered residual sUSDe yield, first-loss cover for senior
Strata Junior USDe::jrUSDe.body: jrUSDe is the junior (first-loss) tranche of Strata's Ethena market, an ERC-4626 token over pooled sUSDe. It gets the sUSDe yield (Ethena funding/basis carry) left after srUSDe is paid its floor, plus the senior's risk premium, so it beats sUSDe when funding is high. When sUSDe yield falls below the Aave benchmark, or on an Ethena loss, jrUSDe pays the shortfall, so its exchange rate can fall and principal can be lost.
Strata Junior USDe::jrUSDe.backing: USDe staked as sUSDe; subordinated to srUSDe
Strata Junior USDe::jrUSDe.yieldSource: residual sUSDe yield (perp funding + basis) after paying senior, plus senior risk premium
Strata Junior USDe::jrUSDe.redemption: instant redeem to sUSDe or USDe after 7-day Ethena cooldown; 10 bps fee; redemptions paused if senior coverage < 105%

Strata Senior NUSD::srNUSD.what: Strata senior tranche of Neutrl sNUSD · sUSDe-rate floor, junior first-loss cover
Strata Senior NUSD::srNUSD.body: srNUSD is the senior (protected) tranche of Strata's Neutrl market, an ERC-4626 token over pooled NUSD that is staked as sNUSD. sNUSD earns Neutrl's market-neutral strategies: OTC arbitrage of discounted locked tokens with hedges, perp funding-rate arbitrage and DeFi strategies. srNUSD takes a share of that yield with a floor at Ethena's sUSDe APY; jrNUSD absorbs underperformance and NUSD default first.
Strata Senior NUSD::srNUSD.backing: NUSD staked as sNUSD, protected by the jrNUSD first-loss tranche
Strata Senior NUSD::srNUSD.yieldSource: sNUSD yield (OTC locked-token arbitrage, funding-rate arbitrage, DeFi), floored at sUSDe APY
Strata Senior NUSD::srNUSD.redemption: permissionless; instant redeem to sNUSD, or NUSD after Neutrl's 10-day unstake; 0-5 bps fee by coverage

Strata Junior NUSD::JRNUSD.what: Strata junior tranche of Neutrl sNUSD · levered residual yield, first loss on NUSD
Strata Junior NUSD::JRNUSD.body: jrNUSD is the junior (first-loss) tranche of Strata's Neutrl market, an ERC-4626 token over pooled sNUSD. It keeps the sNUSD yield (OTC locked-token arbitrage, funding-rate arbitrage, DeFi strategies) left after srNUSD is paid its sUSDe-linked floor, plus the senior's risk premium. It covers any shortfall and is first to lose principal if NUSD becomes insolvent.
Strata Junior NUSD::JRNUSD.backing: NUSD staked as sNUSD; subordinated to srNUSD
Strata Junior NUSD::JRNUSD.yieldSource: residual sNUSD yield after paying senior, plus senior risk premium
Strata Junior NUSD::JRNUSD.redemption: cooldown 0-35 days and 0-20 bps fee depending on senior coverage (+10 days to unstake to NUSD); paused below min coverage

Strata Senior USDat::SRUSDAT.what: Strata senior tranche of Saturn sUSDat · fixed 65% of STRC dividend, junior covers NAV
Strata Senior USDat::SRUSDAT.body: srUSDat is the senior (protected) tranche of Strata's Saturn market, an ERC-4626 token over pooled sUSDat. sUSDat earns T-bill interest and dividends on Strategy's STRC preferred stock, and its NAV moves with STRC's price. srUSDat targets a fixed yield of 65% of the STRC dividend rate with no NAV volatility; jrUSDat absorbs STRC price swings and losses first.
Strata Senior USDat::SRUSDAT.backing: USDat staked as sUSDat (T-bills + Strategy STRC preferred), protected by jrUSDat
Strata Senior USDat::SRUSDAT.yieldSource: STRC preferred dividends and T-bill interest; senior fixed at 65% of STRC dividend rate
Strata Senior USDat::SRUSDAT.redemption: permissionless; instant redeem to sUSDat; 0-5 bps fee by coverage; mint paused below 107.5% coverage

Strata Junior USDat::JRUSDAT.what: Strata junior tranche of Saturn sUSDat · levered STRC dividend yield, first loss on NAV
Strata Junior USDat::JRUSDAT.body: jrUSDat is the junior (first-loss) tranche of Strata's Saturn market, an ERC-4626 token over pooled sUSDat. sUSDat holds T-bills and Strategy's STRC preferred stock; jrUSDat keeps the returns left after paying srUSDat its fixed 65%-of-STRC-dividend yield.
